title: CertificateProfile
description: Complete X.509 certificate profile specification including subject fields, extensions, validity periods, and cryptographic parameters. Supports template inheritance and follows RFC 5280 standards for enterprise PKI environments.

subject_alternative_name.title: SubjectAlternativeNameConfig
subject_alternative_name.description:
Configuration for Subject Alternative Name extension with individual fields for each SAN type.

This configuration supports all standard X.509 Subject Alternative Name types including:

  • Core SAN types: DNS names, email addresses, IP addresses, URIs, etc.
  • Microsoft-specific types: UPN, GUID
  • Kerberos and security types: Kerberos principals, permanent identifiers
  • Smart card and federal types: FASC-N
  • Communication types: XMPP addresses, service names

subject_directory_attributes.title: SubjectDirectoryAttributesConfig
subject_directory_attributes.description:
Configuration for Subject Directory Attributes extension with individual fields for each SDA type. Each field corresponds to a specific SDA type as defined in AvailableSubjectDirectoryAttributes.

This configuration supports all standard X.509 Subject Directory Attribute types from RFC 3739:

  • Personal identification: date of birth, place of birth, gender
  • Citizenship and residence: country of citizenship, country of residence
